segments.title: August
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! August is The Amazing Race, version two. Friendship Day, Independence Day, and a studio-wide race that turns attendance into a sport. Half the city is on holiday. The other half is on our leaderboard.

segments.title: ₹2.05L
segments.text: So, the number. Our August target for Pop-up is 2.05 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last August. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 1.13 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 90,200, and everything else 2,000. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 54 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 631 leads, 164 trials, and 54 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 76,700 rupees, which is 37 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Friends With Benefits (Strictly Fitness)
segments.text: First up, Friends With Benefits. Strictly fitness. Bring a friend who's never been, and they get two classes on us. If they join, you both get race tees, and you get bonus days and double points. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.

segments.title: Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One)
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, Rookie Mistake, the only good one. Two weeks unlimited at an intro price, plus a spot on the rookie leaderboard. The only rookie mistake is not starting. The plan is 4 buyers at about 5,400, so 21,600 rupees.

segments.title: Medal Detector
segments.text: And finally, for race finishers, the Medal Detector. Finish the race and your renewal finds gold. Six months at twenty per cent off plus a private, or three months at fifteen per cent off plus bonus days. The plan is 6 buyers at about 7,200, so 43,400 rupees.
segments.notes: 6M ≈24% effective with private, inside the cap for 6M+ plans

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Friendship Day, and every friend gets two classes on us. Week two, check sell-through every Monday and follow up every trial within a day. Week three, the rookie leaderboard heats up, so celebrate newcomers by name. Week four, race finishers get their Medal Detector renewal.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's August at Pop-up. 2.05 lakh rupees, three offers, and 54 buyers to welcome. On your marks. Get set. Sell.
